advancements.cmd.cmd_adventure.desert_py: Enter a desert pyramid to unlock its disc trail. Mind the blue terracotta; it has trust issues.
Find the Dreamy Deserts disc in a Desert Pyramid.
Find the Dry Hands (Funky Synthwave Track Edition) disc in a Desert Pyramid.
advancements.cmd.cmd_adventure.igloo.str: Find an igloo and investigate its basement for frosty discs.
advancements.cmd.cmd_adventure.igloo.wav: Find the Falling Snow disc in an igloo basement. Someone hid the good soundtrack here.
Find the Crafter's Candy Canes disc in an Igloo. Cold storage, hot track.
advancements.cmd.cmd_adventure.mansion.s: Enter a woodland mansion to hunt for its discs. The illagers did not approve the playlist.
advancements.cmd.cmd_adventure.mansion.w: Find the Haggstrom (John Williams Edition) disc in a Woodland Mansion.
Find the The Arch-Illager disc in a Woodland Mansion.
advancements.cmd.cmd_adventure.root.desc: Explore biomes and structures to uncover their hidden discs.
advancements.cmd.cmd_adventure.trial_cha: Open an ominous vault in a Trial Chamber to obtain Creator. The vault has excellent taste.
Break decorated pots in a Trial Chamber to find Creator (Music Box). Handle the percussion carefully.
Enter a trial chamber to begin looting its discs. Copper grates, louder dates.
Forgotten legends settle into a mellow loop; even heroes need a study break.
A Time of Legends - LoFi Remix
advancements.cmd.cmd_adventure.wave1.wav: Find the Relaxing Aquarium disc in a Shipwreck.
Find the Beach Escape disc in a Jungle Temple.
Find the Glowing Caves disc in an Abandoned Mineshaft. Treasure, but with a better beat.
Find the Serene Snow disc in a Cold Village.
advancements.cmd.cmd_adventure.wave3.wav: Find the C418's Legacy disc in a Dungeon.
Find the Danny (Disney Movie Soundtrack Edition) disc in a Stronghold.
Find the Moog City (Orchestral Synthwave Remix) disc in an Ocean Ruin.
Minecraft's calmest classic, rebuilt entirely from voices and suspiciously precise mouth noises.
advancements.cmd.cmd_adventure.wave6.wav: Find the Deeper - Pixel Remix disc in an Ancient City.
advancements.cmd.cmd_adventure.village.s: Visit any village to begin searching for local discs. Hrrm means encore.
advancements.cmd.cmd_adventure.village.w: Find the Sweden (Calm 3) Acapella disc in a Plains Village.
Find the Makrani Dhun disc in a desert village.
Find the Villager Lullaby disc in a Village.
advancements.cmd.cmd_combat.creeper.kill: Defeat a Creeper to unlock its disc drops. Fuse successfully defused.
advancements.cmd.cmd_combat.creeper.wave: The classic Creeper anthem; one hiss and the whole server knows the chorus.
A highly explosive sing-along with absolutely no insurance coverage.
Defeat a Creeper with a Collector-enchanted weapon for a chance to obtain the BOOM, BOOM, BOOM disc.
Defeat a Charged Creeper with a Collector-enchanted weapon for a chance to obtain the CREEPER RAP REMIX disc.
The mine is back, the instruments are gone, and the mouth percussion is armed.
advancements.cmd.cmd_combat.drowned.kill: Defeat a Drowned to unlock its disc drop. It was making waves anyway.
advancements.cmd.cmd_combat.drowned.wave: Defeat a Drowned with a Collector-enchanted weapon for a chance to obtain the Mice on Venus (Sad Film Score Edition) disc.
Mice on Venus (Sad Film Score Edition)
advancements.cmd.cmd_combat.enderman.kil: Eye contact remains a terrible strategy.
advancements.cmd.cmd_combat.enderman.wav: Defeat an Enderman with a Collector-enchanted weapon for a chance to obtain the Don't mess with the Endermen disc.
advancements.cmd.cmd_combat.pigman.kill_: Defeat a Zombified Piglin. The rest of the Nether has been notified.
advancements.cmd.cmd_combat.pigman.wave3: Defeat a Zombified Piglin with a Collector-enchanted weapon for a chance to obtain the Pigman disc.
advancements.cmd.cmd_combat.root.descrip: Defeat hostile mobs to discover their disc drops.
advancements.cmd.cmd_combat.root.title: Custom Music Discs: Combat
advancements.cmd.cmd_combat.skeleton.kil: Defeat a Skeleton. A rattling review is still a review.
advancements.cmd.cmd_combat.skeleton.wav: Defeat a Skeleton with a Collector-enchanted weapon for a chance to obtain the I've Got A Bone disc.
Bones rattle on beat, proving calcium is a perfectly valid percussion section.
advancements.cmd.cmd_combat.spider.kill_: Defeat a Spider. Eight legs, zero rhythm.
advancements.cmd.cmd_combat.spider.wave3: Defeat a Spider with a Collector-enchanted weapon for a chance to obtain the Bull Is The Spider disc.
advancements.cmd.cmd_combat.zombie.kill_: Defeat a Zombie. Brains were never part of the playlist.
advancements.cmd.cmd_combat.zombie.wave3: Defeat a Zombie with a Collector-enchanted weapon for a chance to obtain the I'm A Zombie disc.
advancements.cmd.cmd_combat.wave3.wave3_: Defeat the Warden with a Collector-enchanted weapon for a chance to obtain the Quiet Please! disc.
Defeat a Snow Golem with a Collector-enchanted weapon for a chance to obtain the The Ballad of Bob The Snow Golem disc.
The Ballad of Bob The Snow Golem
advancements.cmd.cmd_combat.wave6.wave6_: Defeat an Elder Guardian with a Collector-enchanted weapon for a chance to obtain the Eld Unknown - Pixel Remix disc.
advancements.cmd.cmd_dimensional.end.ent: Enter the End to unlock its disc trail. The void has surprisingly good acoustics.
advancements.cmd.cmd_dimensional.end.wav: Find the Living Mice (Synthwave Edition) disc in an End City.
Find the Sweden (LoFi Hip-Hop Remix) disc in an End City.
A lonely End horizon turned into a soft loop for builders above the void.
Alone with the Sky - LoFi Remix
Find the Watcher - Pixel Remix disc in an End City.
The final chapter of a fallen kingdom, powered by dragons and unresolved feelings.
Enter the Nether to unlock its disc trail. Fire resistance does not protect your ears.
Loot a Bastion Remnant chest to find Pigstep. The Piglins prefer that you call this borrowing.
Find the Fort-stress disc in a Nether Fortress. Speedrunners know the feeling.
Find the Aria Math (Synthwave Edition) disc in a Nether Fortress.
Pigstep traded the bastion club for a full orchestra and kept every ounce of swagger.
Crimson Forest ambience with the danger turned down and the chill turned up.
A Nether lullaby where every distant scream somehow lands on the beat.
advancements.cmd.cmd_dimensional.root.de: Travel beyond the Dimensions to find dimensional discs. Bring blocks; void insurance is not included.
advancements.cmd.cmd_special.challange_b: Collect a special music disc. The real challenge is storage space.
advancements.cmd.cmd_special.root.descri: Complete major challenges to earn special discs. Bragging rights now come on vinyl.
advancements.cmd.cmd_special.root.title: Custom Music Discs: Special
advancements.cmd.cmd_special.wave3.wave3: Complete Monsters Hunted to earn the Aria Math (Epic Soundtrack Edition) disc. Your next build montage is sorted.
Defeat the Ender Dragon to obtain the Sweden (Hans Zimmer Edition) disc. The credits now have a trailer score.
Collect every CMD disc to earn Sweden (Hans Zimmer Edition) (slowed + reverb). Completion sounds suspiciously nostalgic.
Complete Adventuring Time to earn the Wet Hands (Uplifting Adventurous Soundtrack Edition) disc. Exploration now has a proper score.
advancements.cmd.cmd_special.wave6.wave6: Complete The End... Again... to earn the Endless - Pixel Remix disc. The track ends when the adventure does. So, never.
Complete Caves & Cliffs to earn the Featherfall - Pixel Remix disc. You fell stylishly.
Complete Subspace Bubble to earn the pokopoko - Pixel Remix disc. Joy, compressed into tiny pixel bubbles.
Complete Hero of the Village to earn the yakusoku - Pixel Remix disc. The village finally paid in something besides emeralds.
advancements.cmd.cmd_special.wave7.wave7: A hopeful treasure-hunt anthem for anyone who checked the same chest twice.
Collect any Creeper-drop music disc. Let a Skeleton do the shooting; you take the royalties.
advancements.cmd.cmd_story.collector_boo: Obtain a Collector-enchanted book at any level. Your mixtape hunt just got easier.
advancements.cmd.cmd_story.craft_jukebox: Craft a jukebox to play your collection. Diamonds finally have a practical use.
advancements.cmd.cmd_story.root.descript: Begin your Custom Music Discs collection. Thanks for downloading; your jukebox has plans.
advancements.cmd.cmd_story.root.title: Custom Music Discs
advancements.cmd.cmd_story.wave1.wave1_s: Cook any music disc on a campfire to make the Fireplace disc. Who let the campfire cook?
advancements.cmd.cmd_story.wave1.wave1_w: Fish up the Wet Hands Acapella disc as treasure. The fish were handling distribution.
advancements.cmd.cmd_story.wave4.relic.d: Brush suspicious gravel in a Trail Ruin to uncover Relic. Dusty, but the groove survived.
advancements.cmd.cmd_story.wave4.wave4_m: The Disc is named after one of Sweden's historical provinces and counties, Dalarna.
Dungeons & Campsites with a spin with more haze and the same homesick groove.
Relic returns dusted in amethyst and wrapped in a much smoother beat.
advancements.cmd.cmd_story.wave4.wave4_r: Duplicate Relic by surrounding it with diamonds. Archaeology, now with a photocopier.
advancements.cmd.wave1.jsab.wave1_jsab_b: Obtain any JSaB disc to reveal this branch. Geometry has entered the jukebox.
advancements.cmd.wave1.jsab.wave1_jsab_c: A clockwork pulse where missing one beat feels suspiciously like respawning.
Glitched edges, broken code, and a beat that refuses to crash.
advancements.cmd.wave1.jsab.wave1_jsab_g: Binary gates open to a track with more logic than the average redstone machine.
advancements.cmd.wave1.jsab.wave1_jsab_m: The calm before the geometric storm; press start whenever the cubes stop judging.
Interstellar bass for crossing galaxies, no elytra fuel required.
advancements.cmd.wave1.wave1_fallen_king: A royal tragedy in music-disc form; the kingdom fell, but the chorus still rules.
The Minecraft soundtrack recreated with nothing but voices and heroic breath control.
advancements.cmd.wave1.wave1_mcacapella2: More vocal blocks, more mouth percussion, and a sequel that earned its number.
advancements.cmd.wave1.wave1_onlynoteblo: Every melody comes from note blocks, because instruments were apparently too easy.
Customer-service limbo has never sounded this patient or this catchy.
advancements.cmd.wave1.wave1_pleasehold_: Grian is still making forms at the Permit Office. Please Hold.
advancements.cmd.wave1.wave1_root.descri: Obtain any Wave 1 disc to unlock this collection. One disc down; your storage problem begins.
advancements.cmd.wave1.wave1_root.title: CMD Wave 1
advancements.cmd.wave1.wave1_soothing_ch: Soft petals, bright chords, and enough calm to forgive one misplaced log.
advancements.cmd.wave1.wave1_soothing_ra: Rain taps the rhythm while swamp frogs provide unofficial backing vocals.
advancements.cmd.wave1.wave1_subwoolfer_: A bedtime classic sung without instruments; the subwoofer is metaphorical this time.
advancements.cmd.wave2.wave2_bitch_lasag: A diss track served cold, layered with memes, and not approved by an Italian chef.
advancements.cmd.wave2.wave2_congratulat: A victory lap for winning the subscriber war; the diamond play button is still decorative.
advancements.cmd.wave2.wave2_dan_craftin: A love song to the block that turns punching trees into civilization.
Maximum psychic damage, remixed into something dangerously danceable.
advancements.cmd.wave2.wave2_dan_dab_las: The Dab Police theme: part lasagna, part siren, entirely a product of its era.
advancements.cmd.wave2.wave2_dan_gingerb: A gingerbread breakdown with enough energy to escape the cookie tray.
advancements.cmd.wave2.wave2_dan_happeni: The musical equivalent of every redstone lamp turning on at once.
advancements.cmd.wave2.wave2_dan_im_dead: A respawn-screen anthem for when the beat drops harder than your inventory.
advancements.cmd.wave2.wave2_dan_intro.d: One red choice, one dramatic voice, and no blue option in sight.
advancements.cmd.wave2.wave2_dan_intro.t: The Red one has been chosen
A cliffhanger in song form; what happens next remains legally classified.
advancements.cmd.wave2.wave2_dan_monster: The monster inside got a remix and immediately demanded top billing.
Dan and the Nether remain in a complicated relationship, with Netherrack as witness.
Never Ever Going to the Nether
advancements.cmd.wave2.wave2_dan_smashin: An anvil-breaking burst of confidence for days when merely succeeding is not enough.
advancements.cmd.wave2.wave2_dan_song.de: Today I set myself the challenge of making a song in under 4 hours.. this is what I made.
advancements.cmd.wave2.wave2_mario_in_th: Final-boss drama from deep inside Bowser, where even digestion gets battle music.
advancements.cmd.wave2.wave2_offpepperst: OFF's battle theme arrives sizzling and intense.
advancements.cmd.wave2.wave2_root.descri: Obtain any Wave 2 disc to unlock this collection. One disc down; your storage problem begins.
advancements.cmd.wave2.wave2_root.title: CMD Wave 2
advancements.cmd.wave3.wave3_mcrap_busy_: Bee bars straight from the hive; the honey is optional, the buzz is not.
advancements.cmd.wave3.wave3_mcrap_just_: This Minecraft mob song became about something much more than a fox... these things happen.
advancements.cmd.wave3.wave3_mcrap_rap_b: Pixels face plastic bricks in a lyrical showdown with dangerously sharp corners.
advancements.cmd.wave3.wave3_mcrap_the_l: An ode to the Allay: tiny wings, huge loyalty, and suspiciously good rhythm.
advancements.cmd.wave3.wave3_mcsoundtrac: The Minecraft soundtrack hits its anime arc: friendship, parkour, and excessive opening credits.
advancements.cmd.wave3.wave3_mice_on_ven: Mice on Venus without instruments; the mice have taken over the choir.
advancements.cmd.wave3.wave3_never_gonna: The oldest trap in the link becomes a permanent feature of your jukebox.
advancements.cmd.wave3.wave3_root.descri: Obtain any Wave 3 disc to unlock this collection. One disc down; your storage problem begins.
advancements.cmd.wave3.wave3_root.title: CMD Wave 3
advancements.cmd.wave3.wave3_subwoofer_l: A familiar lullaby grows into a full orchestra.
advancements.cmd.wave4.dungeons.dungeons: Obtain any Minecraft Dungeons disc to reveal this branch. The mobs approve the soundtrack.
advancements.cmd.wave4.dungeons.wave4_mc: The Heart of Ender broke once; the lo-fi beat is handling recovery.
Broken Heart of Ender - LoFi Remix
Bubble-soft beats rise through a coral reef with zero risk of drowning.
A desert temple groove with the trap disarmed and the chill left untouched.
Dark magic trades fangs for frequencies; the Vexes are still not invited.
A windswept Dungeons melody made for long walks across blocky plains.
The rarest bovine island now moos in stereo.
The Arch-Illager's boss theme relaxes just enough to postpone the next invasion.
advancements.cmd.wave4.legends.legends_b: Obtain any Minecraft Legends disc to reveal this branch. Heroism, now at study-beat volume.
advancements.cmd.wave4.legends.wave4_mcl: A sunrise worth waiting through the whole night for, now with softer drums.
A Day Long Awaited - LoFi Remix
A fresh world, worn boots, and the first mellow steps of another legend.
New Worlds, New Adventures - LoFi Remix
An approaching war scored like a study session; conflict has never been this cozy.
An endless green horizon translated into warm, wandering lo-fi.
Fate makes its final choice with a little delay, reverb, and considerably less panic.
The Well of Fate - LoFi Remix
advancements.cmd.wave4.mining.mining_bra: Obtain any mining remix to reveal this branch. Home is where the crafting table is.
Home Is Where the Crafting Table Is
advancements.cmd.wave4.mining.wave4_mclo: Four walls, one furnace, and the unmistakable sound of finally being home.
A lush cave melody caught photosynthesizing with headphones on.
Moonlit dunes roll beneath a beat smoother than sandstone.
Wind carries a quiet melody between leaves and mine shafts.
Echo In The Wind - LoFi Remix
Sweden finally found its words; your pickaxe may start singing along.
advancements.cmd.wave4.wave4_hardcore_di: Hardcore mode translated into pure BPM: no pauses, no mercy, no spare hearts.
advancements.cmd.wave4.wave4_mclofi_blue: Sub-zero lo-fi for sliding faster than your dignity can recover.
Blue Ice, White Snow - LoFi Remix
advancements.cmd.wave4.wave4_mclofi_lute: A brief bard break from saving the Overworld; the villagers requested an encore.
advancements.cmd.wave4.wave4_root.descri: Obtain any Wave 4 disc to unlock this collection. One disc down; your storage problem begins.
advancements.cmd.wave4.wave4_root.title: CMD Wave 4
advancements.cmd.wave4.wave4_sweet_dream: Eighties synth-pop wandered into Minecraft and started traveling the seven biomes.
advancements.cmd.wave5.undertale.wave5_d: A save-point glow pressed onto a disc; quitting is still not an option.
All bark, no orchestra, and somehow still a masterpiece.
advancements.cmd.wave5.undertale.wave5_e: The battle has not started, but the soundtrack already rolled initiative.
advancements.cmd.wave5.undertale.wave5_f: A gentle tumble into the Underground, softened by one very emotional melody.
advancements.cmd.wave5.undertale.wave5_g: Napstablook brought the beats; cheering them up remains the real boss fight.
advancements.cmd.wave5.undertale.wave5_h: A warm, painful boss theme for anyone who tried to spare Toriel.
Toriel's home in musical form: warm pie, soft firelight, zero worries.
The same safe melody wound into a tiny box with extra twinkle.
advancements.cmd.wave5.undertale.wave5_o: The opening page of Undertale, where nostalgia begins before the story does.
advancements.cmd.wave5.undertale.wave5_r: Dusty corridors, purple bricks, and one suspiciously comforting melody.
advancements.cmd.wave5.undertale.wave5_s: A laid-back skeleton theme with one period and several future bad times.
Crunching snow, cold air, and a melody warmer than Papyrus's cooking.
advancements.cmd.wave5.undertale.wave5_u: Obtain any Undertale disc to reveal this branch.
Seventy-two degrees, partly cloudy, and completely adorable.
advancements.cmd.wave5.wave5_minecraft_s: A soundtrack for dreamers, builders, and terraformers who forgot what natural terrain looked like.
advancements.cmd.wave5.wave5_root.descri: Obtain any Wave 5 disc to unlock this collection. One disc down; your storage problem begins.
advancements.cmd.wave5.wave5_root.title: CMD Wave 5
advancements.cmd.wave5.wave5_soothing_fa: Morning chores become lo-fi: feed animals, harvest wheat, repeat until relaxed.
advancements.cmd.wave5.wave5_thefatrat_f: An airborne anthem for elytra pilots who consider clouds a suggested speed limit.
advancements.cmd.wave5.wave5_thefatrat_s: Sea-lantern glow and open water turn every boat trip into a music video.
advancements.cmd.wave6.wave6_copper_gole: The little button-pusher finally gets a theme, oxidation and all.
advancements.cmd.wave6.wave6_forrest_fra: A bright reminder that the best path may be the one nobody else suggested.
advancements.cmd.wave6.wave6_giftwrapped: Festive strings surround a beat that was absolutely opened before the holiday.
advancements.cmd.wave6.wave6_happy_ghast: A Nether melody with fewer tears and one cheerful floating marshmallow.
advancements.cmd.wave6.wave6_infinite_am: Amethyst echoes loop forever, compressed into bright pixel sparks.
advancements.cmd.wave6.wave6_infinite_sp: A creaking forest twists amethyst ambience into something beautifully unsettling.
advancements.cmd.wave6.wave6_komorebi_pi: Sunlight through leaves translated into tiny pixels and a peaceful pulse.
advancements.cmd.wave6.wave6_nautilus.de: Deep-ocean ambience spirals outward like a shell with surround sound.
advancements.cmd.wave6.wave6_root.descri: Obtain any Wave 6 disc to unlock this collection. One disc down; your storage problem begins.
advancements.cmd.wave6.wave6_root.title: CMD Wave 6
advancements.cmd.wave6.wave6_spears.desc: A sharp new combat theme; yes, that is the point.
advancements.cmd.wave6.wave6_the_copper_: Copper enters its industrial era with gears, weathering, and a surprisingly catchy anthem.
advancements.cmd.wave6.wave6_wondrous_wo: Search a snowy village to find the Wondrous Workshop disc. Santa outsourced the soundtrack.
advancements.cmd.wave7.wave7_dont_mine_a: A classic nighttime warning that remains easier to sing than to follow.
advancements.cmd.wave7.wave7_find_the_pi: A broken kingdom scatters its clues across one determined anthem.
advancements.cmd.wave7.wave7_rising_king: A new kingdom rises from the ruins, paperwork and border disputes pending.
advancements.cmd.wave7.wave7_root.descri: Obtain any Wave 7 disc to unlock this collection. One disc down; your storage problem begins.
advancements.cmd.wave7.wave7_root.title: CMD Wave 7
advancements.cmd.wave7.wave7_take_back_t: The night loses custody of the darkness in this triumphant sequel.
advancements.cmd_structures.cmd_story.cm: Find the Music Weaponsmith in the Badlands. Forged in fire, tempered in rhythm.
Find the Music Cleric in a dark forest. Healing potions now come with playlists.
Find the Music Librarian in the mountains. Please return all discs by sunrise.
advancements.cmd_structures.cmd_story.ma: Locate the MAYDAY ship and search it for some discs. The distress signal has a bassline.
advancements.cmd_structures.cmd_story.sh: Find the floating cake shrine. Sacrefice a cake and a disc will be granted.
advancements.cmd_structures.cmd_story.st: Discover any structure added by Custom Music Discs.
advancements.cmd_structures.cmd_story.un: Locate an Underchamber. The acoustics are deep; so is the danger.
advancements.cmd_structures.cmd_story.wa: Complete the cake ritual at the floating shrine to obtain Happy Birthday! The cake is not a lie, just ceremonial.
Trade with the Music Weaponsmith in the Badlands for the Creator - Pixel Remix disc. The forge of creation has a rhythm.
Trade with the Music Cleric in a dark forest for the Precipice - Pixel Remix disc. Brewed right on the edge of reason.
Trade with the Music Librarian in the mountains for the Puzzlebox - Pixel Remix disc. The box was hiding a beat.
Search the MAYDAY ship to find the Mayday (feat. Laura Brehm) disc. The distress signal has a bassline.
